_comment: Electro / Flashcards animal pairs. Hand-edit to add matches. 'img' is a filename stem in assets/graphics/pools/animals/ (no extension). 'say' is the spoken + printed word. If you add an entry, also add its word to tools/gen-voice.sh so a baked clip ships (otherwise it falls back to live TTS). Regenerate the full list from the art with tools/gen-electro-data.sh.
